positive_force: Has a strong passion for comics (creating is the center of his life)
Has a supportive group of friends who often give positive feedback
In other areas (such as job hunting) has previously been able to view rejection more objectively; has transferable coping resources
negative_force: Catastrophic fortune telling: firmly believes 'no one will publish it'
Dismisses positive feedback, focuses excessively on possible rejection
Overgeneralization and personalization: equating a single rejection with total failure and attributing it to oneself not being good enough
Finds it hard to open up self-doubt to friends, so the support network is hard to fully utilize
